"Create a top-down 2D cricket game in HTML5/JS with a large stadium boundary and realistic batting physics (shot timing, angle, power, edge detection). Include varied bowler types (Fast, Swing, Off-Spin, Leg-Spin) with random lengths and speeds. 

Implement a strict batter career mode starting at 0 Club Rating. Skill rating must change exclusively based on match performance (gained for runs/not outs, lost for poor scores/ducks), with zero external or manual upgrades. Include dynamic HUD, post-match summaries, and progressive difficulty tiers.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
